title: RQ4-M1 Transition-Confidence Decomposition: decomposing cardinality-induced reliability degradation into correctness-state transition and confidence-ranking change
amendments_before_any_result: tail-pressure status corrected from a duplicate-of-existing wording to NOT USED with the accurate reason (per-candidate raw scores absent from the frozen artifacts; a new model forward would be required and is forbidden)
input_artifact_manifest.csv added (18 hashed prediction artifacts + the published C1 reference) and registered here as input_manifest_sha256
D_conf clarified as a confidence-RANKING-change contribution, explicitly not a temperature / calibration-scale change (AUROC is invariant to monotone score transforms)
cross-family own-cohort CIs renamed as descriptive under independent-family resampling and explicitly not paired-expression
amendment_discipline: all four items are wording / inventory corrections made while no real RPN, DETR or GDINO number had been computed; no formula, estimator, cohort, coverage, threshold or verdict label was changed
classification_meaning: An exact accounting decomposition of an already-settled confirmatory effect (V2-P C1: the K5->K50 AUROC degradation replicates on RPN, DETR-R50 and GDINO). It creates no existence claim, tests no intervention, and authorises no new method. It may say that one measured component 'accounts for' more of a measured difference than another; it may never say 'causes', 'is the mechanism', or 'discovered the mechanism'.
not: new GO/NO-GO gate or new threshold hunt

authorisation.required_by_that_registration: a new pre-result frozen mechanism amendment, which is this file

scientific_question.RQ4-M1-Q1: Is the K5->K50 reliability degradation primarily associated with correctness-state transitions, confidence reordering, or both?
scientific_question.RQ4-M1-Q2: Which of these two structural components accounts for the unusually large GDINO AUROC degradation relative to RPN and DETR?
scientific_question.wording_rule: answer with 'accounts for in the exact statistical decomposition'; never with 'causes' or 'is the causal mechanism'

why_this_is_not_variable_fishing: The previously observed candidate properties (R1 same-class distractors, R2 unmatched COCO fraction, R4 geometric redundancy, R5 query cosine spread, H2a delta margin) were all seen inside the V2-P2-M result and remain 'candidate observations' only. RQ4-M1 uses none of them as an explanatory variable. It uses exactly two things that were already published and are not chosen by significance: the correctness state (r5, r50) and the frozen confidence (p5, p50), in one pre-defined exact decomposition. Nothing is selected because it looks significant.

data.comparison: K5 (baseline) vs K50 (primary), nested seeded-random regime, pooled test (testA + testB)
data.confidence_definition: conf_msp is the frozen global_T_corrected confidence (B3 max-softmax at the frozen per-seed temperature) - the identical column the confirmatory C1 gate used. It is read as stored; it is never recomputed, recalibrated or refit.
data.correctness_definition: 'correct' is the stored binary 1[argmax == target] per (family, K, seed), the identical column the confirmatory C1 gate used.
data.cohort: per family, the common-K50 cohort = the sentence_id set of that family's own random_k50 npz, intersected with its random_k5 npz; rows are sorted by sentence_id so K5 and K50 align row-for-row. This must equal the published cohort_rows (RPN 10286 / DETR 9665 / GDINO 10402) and the published per-seed n; any mismatch is a stop condition, not a repair opportunity.
forbidden_inputs: any model forward pass, detector/CLIP/B3 inference, or GPU use
any new feature extraction or candidate generation
any proposal bank (cache/*.h5), corpus construction or manifest read: RQ4-M1 needs only the stored per-row prediction columns
any new proposal family, new dataset, new split, new seed, new training
any recomputation of the confirmatory C1 numbers: they are read, not re-derived, and any drift stops the run
data.zero_delta_attestation: this amendment adds no trained parameter, no model forward pass, no feature and no GPU use; it consumes only the 18 frozen prediction artifacts hashed in input_artifact_manifest

input_artifact_manifest.built_in: the freeze round, by scripts/rq4_m1_decomposition.py --write-input-manifest: file metadata and sha256 only, no prediction array was loaded
input_artifact_manifest.rows: 18 prediction artifacts (3 families x {K5, K50} x 3 frozen B3 seeds) plus 1 published reference artifact (results/v2_proposal_robustness/p2_c1_gdino/c1_point.csv)
input_artifact_manifest.row_count_provenance: row_count_from_metadata_if_available is the already-published c1_point.csv 'n' column for that family / seed / K (cohort rows). The npz file's OWN row count is DEFERRED to the result round, because obtaining it would require loading a prediction array; leaving it deferred keeps 'no real row access before freeze' true instead of being violated just to fill a column.
input_artifact_manifest.consumption_rule: all real analyses must consume exactly these hashed artifacts: the result round re-hashes every path in this manifest and aborts (FreezeViolation / StopCondition) on any sha256 or file_size drift, so the decomposition can only run on the frozen inputs registered here
input_artifact_manifest.no_new_artifacts: the manifest is an inventory of existing frozen artifacts; it authorises no additional prediction file, model, dataset or seed

definitions.per_row_inputs: for one family, one seed, one aligned common-K50 cohort: r5 = correct@K5, r50 = correct@K50, p5 = conf_msp@K5, p50 = conf_msp@K50
definitions.auroc_estimator: ccg.metrics.discrimination.auroc_correct - the tie-correct Mann-Whitney average-rank statistic, identical to sklearn.metrics.roc_auc_score (0.5 credit for ties). Single-class inputs give nan and are a stop condition, never silently dropped.
definitions.reproduction_constraint: A00 must reproduce the published K5 auroc_correct and A11 the published K50 auroc_correct for the same (family, seed) to 1e-12; the check compares against c1_point.csv, it does not replace it
definitions.observed_change: delta_total = A11 - A00 (negative when reliability degrades)
definitions.degradation: D_total = A00 - A11 = -delta_total (positive when reliability degrades)
definitions.d_conf_meaning: D_conf is a CONFIDENCE-RANKING-CHANGE contribution: with correctness labels held fixed at a Shapley corner, it measures the AUROC change induced by the K5 -> K50 confidence ordering across expressions. It is NOT a temperature or calibration-scale change: AUROC is invariant to monotone transforms of the score, so a pure rescaling of confidence (a refit temperature applied uniformly) contributes exactly zero to D_conf. Only a re-ordering of expressions by confidence can move it. This clarification changes no formula: the corners A00/A10/A01/A11, the Shapley weights L/C and the definitions D_label = -L, D_conf = -C are exactly as frozen above.

factors.L (label transition): the correctness labels move r5 -> r50
factors.C (confidence change): the frozen confidences move p5 -> p50, i.e. the cross-expression confidence ORDERING changes (a ranking effect, not a scale/temperature effect - AUROC is invariant to monotone score transforms)

formulas.identity: L + C == A11 - A00 (symmetric two-factor Shapley; exact by construction)

decomposition.residual_rule: the float64 residual of both identities is recorded per family and seed and must be <= 1e-12 in absolute value
decomposition.sign_policy: D_label and D_conf are SIGNED and may be positive, negative, or larger than D_total; a negative component means that factor improved reliability while the other worsened it more. Clipping to zero, absolute-value renormalisation and forcing shares to sum to 100% are all forbidden.

shares.definition: share_label = D_label / D_total, share_conf = D_conf / D_total
shares.kind: signed descriptive share; values below 0 or above 1 are legitimate and are reported as they are
shares.denominator_safety: shares are omitted (reported as empty with a flag) when |D_total| < 1e-3. The floor is 1/50th of the SMALLEST published degradation in this program (RPN delta AUROC 0.0517), chosen before results so that it can only ever exclude a numerically degenerate denominator; all three families are expected to clear it comfortably.
shares.aggregation: family-level quantities are the mean over the 3 frozen B3 seeds (the same headline convention as C1); every per-seed value is also written

transition_groups.partition_rule: the four groups are exhaustive and disjoint by construction; the driver asserts the union covers every row
transition_groups.structural_invariant: G == 0 is EXPECTED (C5 is a subset of C50 and the scorer is per-candidate independent, so a target that lost top-1 inside C5 cannot regain it by adding candidates), but it is treated as a RUNTIME invariant, not as an assumption
transition_groups.invariant_failure: if G > 0 for ANY family or seed -> STRUCTURAL_INVARIANT_FAILURE, STOP, report, do not continue the analysis and do not rescue it

group_weight_identities.precondition: G == 0 (else the label sets below are not the corner label sets)
group_weight_identities.at_K5: positives = S union F, negatives = E; A00 = (nS*AUC(S,E;p5) + nF*AUC(F,E;p5)) / (nS + nF)
group_weight_identities.at_K50: positives = S, negatives = F union E; A11 = (nF*AUC(S,F;p50) + nE*AUC(S,E;p50)) / (nF + nE)
group_weight_identities.cross_corners: A01 and A10 carry the same partition at the other score level, so all four corners are reconstructed from group pairs
group_weight_identities.pairwise_auc_definition: AUC(X,Y;p) = P(p_X > p_Y) + 0.5 * P(p_X == p_Y), the same average-rank estimator restricted to the two groups; exact because the corner's pair set partitions into the two cross-group pair families, each normalised by its own pair count
group_weight_identities.tolerance: reconstructed minus direct must be <= 1e-12 in absolute value for every corner

per_family_seed: mean and median p5 in S/F/E
mean and median p50 in S/F/E
transition_diagnostics.key_quantity: AUC(S,F;p50): a low value means the newly introduced errors keep a high confidence at K50 and therefore damage the ranking specifically; reported next to AUC(S,E;p50) to separate newly introduced from persistent errors

selective_error_sources.purpose: explain the composition of the accepted errors behind the published RER@50 / RER@80 degradation. This is NOT a new gate and adds no new decision.
selective_error_sources.acceptance_rule: at K50, accept the most confident rows under the frozen selective convention: n_keep = max(1, ceil(coverage * n)), rows in descending p50 with a stable sort (identical to ccg.metrics.selective.selective_accuracy)
reported: fraction of accepted errors coming from F

cross_family_gap.identity: D_total(a) - D_total(b) = (D_label(a) - D_label(b)) + (D_conf(a) - D_conf(b)), exact by subtraction of two exact identities
cross_family_gap.reported: gap total, label component, confidence component, residual, signed shares, and which component is heavier
cross_family_gap.prejudgement: the decomposition does NOT presuppose whether label transitions or confidence changes carry the gap; both components are reported and the heavier one is named descriptively

bootstrap.sampler: ccg.experiment.phase0a._ClusterSampler - the frozen design used by every C1 CI in this program
bootstrap.shared_draws_within_family: one draw per replicate is applied to r5, r50, p5 and p50 simultaneously (they are the same rows), so every identity holds inside each replicate
bootstrap.seed_handling: each replicate re-runs the SAME estimator (mean over the 3 seeds) as the point estimate
bootstrap.cross_family_rule: family-specific bootstraps are run SEPARATELY on each family's own cohort; the gap CI is built from replicate-index-aligned differences of those independent draws. NAME DISCIPLINE: these cross-family own-cohort CIs are DESCRIPTIVE under independent-family resampling and are NOT paired-expression CIs - the two families' cohorts differ, so no expression-level pairing is claimed and the interval is always labelled 'independent-family resampling, not paired-expression'. Genuine paired secondary inference comes ONLY from the matched-expression intersection resampled with SHARED image-cluster draws (see secondary_matched). The statistical method itself is unchanged by this naming tightening.

secondary_matched.cohort_rule: deterministic sentence_id intersection of the two families' own common-K50 cohorts (the same construction the frozen C1 intersections used)
secondary_matched.design: on a matched intersection both families are restricted to identical expression rows and resampled with SHARED image-cluster draws, so the gap there is paired-expression
secondary_matched.authority: never overrides the primary own-cohort result; it only reports whether the same decomposition ordering survives cohort matching

statistics.no_new_tests: no p-values, no significance language, no new statistical test. Bootstrap intervals describe sampling variability of a descriptive quantity.

excluded_from_primary.status: candidate observations only, already seen inside the V2-P2-M result; they may be cited in a Discussion as previously measured properties but may not enter the primary decomposition, may not be re-selected for significance, and may not be renamed as the mechanism

added_candidate_tail_pressure.frozen_definition: A = C50 \ C5; tail_pressure = (max raw score over A - s1_5) / (abs(s1_5 - s2_5) + 1e-8)
added_candidate_tail_pressure.reason: required per-candidate raw scores are unavailable in the frozen prediction artifacts; computing this quantity would require a new model forward / new score extraction, which is forbidden by RQ4-M1
added_candidate_tail_pressure.evidence: the 18 frozen prediction npz files store only per-row aggregates (sentence_id, ref_id, image_id, correct, conf_msp, conf_stats, conf_e1b, sem14, raw_top1, raw_margin12) - there is no per-candidate score array and no record of the scores of the added candidates C50 \ C5, so the quantity cannot be recovered offline from the frozen artifacts
added_candidate_tail_pressure.duplicate_of_existing_claim: NOT MADE. No mathematically equivalent quantity is frozen in this repository: raw_top1@K50 minus raw_top1@K5 is a per-row top-1 score SHIFT of the whole cohort, not a margin-normalised intrusion of the added-candidate tail, and it is not the same functional. Inability to compute is recorded as inability to compute, not as duplication.
added_candidate_tail_pressure.consequence: no secondary score-intrusion metric is reported this round, and no replacement variable is added in its place

verdict.primary: DECOMPOSITION_REPORTED - this value is a constant, because an exact accounting decomposition cannot succeed or fail; the identity either holds (checked) or the run stops

descriptive_ordering_per_family.no_tolerance: no approximate-equality band is invented; the two values and their difference are reported and the ordering is stated mechanically

verdict.no_thresholds: this round deliberately introduces no 0.50 / 0.70 / 2-of-3 style bar: those belong to intervention or replication gates, not to an exact decomposition

stop_conditions.structural_invariant: G > 0 in any family or seed -> STRUCTURAL_INVARIANT_FAILURE, STOP before any decomposition output is written
stop_conditions.reproduction: A00 or A11 differs from the published per-seed C1 AUROC by more than 1e-12 -> STOP (the frozen predictions or the cohort are not the ones the confirmatory result used)
stop_conditions.cohort_identity: derived cohort size differs from the published cohort_rows / per-seed n -> STOP, no rescue by loosening the cohort
stop_conditions.degenerate_groups: any of S, F, E empty for a family-seed -> STOP and report; a corner with a single class yields nan, which is never dropped or averaged away
stop_conditions.identity_residual: any Shapley or group-reconstruction residual above 1e-12 -> STOP and report the residual; do not widen the tolerance after the fact
stop_conditions.seed_count: fewer than 3 seeds available for a family -> STOP (the analysis is defined on exactly the frozen B3 seeds)

outputs.figure_policy: exactly these three figures; no exploratory figure set

allowed: The observed AUROC degradation can be exactly decomposed into a correctness-transition component and a confidence-change component.
The larger GDINO degradation is statistically accounted for more by X than by Y in this decomposition.
forbidden: unmatched boxes / H2a / semantic ambiguity is the cause
any causal or intervention wording without a separate pre-result frozen intervention protocol
interpretation_boundary.phrase_rule: use 'accounts for in the exact statistical decomposition', never 'causes' or 'is the causal mechanism'
